steps: Follow the game's natural opening path north out of the Stormveil outskirts.
Rest at a Site of Grace or defeat Margit — the Roundtable Hold invitation triggers once the game decides you have progressed far enough.
Cross the bridge north of the Stormveil Castle entrance to reach the fog wall.
Fight Margit outside Stormveil Castle. He is weak to bleed attacks, so a bleed build trivialises this fight.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Margit's Shackle, bought from Patches south of the Third Church of Marika, can pin him down twice for free hits — and it carries into the later Godrick fight.

steps: Work through Stormveil Castle to the boss arena at the top of the main keep.
Defeat Godrick. In phase two he grafts a dragon head to his arm — roll away from the slam and punish after.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Margit's Shackle from Patches can be used here too, which makes this one of the easier major bosses.

achievements.name: Great Rune
achievements.description: Restore the power of a Great Rune at a Divine Tower.

steps: Defeat a Shardbearer to claim its Great Rune.
Carry the rune to the matching Divine Tower and activate it at the summit.
warnings: Missable. Every Divine Tower is reachable on foot, but some towers are guarded or sit in late-game areas. More importantly, kindling the Erdtree makes Divine Towers hostile and closes off the other endings — do this last.

achievements.name: Red Wolf of Radagon
achievements.description: Defeat the Red Wolf of Radagon.

steps: Enter the Redmane Castle festival arena in southern Caelid during the Radahn Festival.
Defeat the Red Wolf. It is fast and staggers often, so heavy weapons punish it well.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Summon every NPC you have discovered — the festival buffs them and several summonable bosses can turn this into an easy win.

achievements.name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
achievements.description: Defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

steps: Make your way through the Raya Lucaria Academy in west Liurnia.
Fight Rennala in the church chamber. Phase one has her students with golden auras attacking — deal with those first. Phase two is the queen directly, fighting much more aggressively.
Find Castle Morne on the western peninsula in the Weeping Peninsula.
Fight the Leonine Misbegotten at the back of the castle.
Progress through Caria Manor in the northwest of Liurnia, resolving Ranni's quest as you go.
Defeat Loretta at the end of the manor, just before her sister.
Reach the Radahn Festival arena in southern Caelid.
Summon as many NPCs as you have met and fight Starscourge Radahn. The fight starts at half health — bring heals.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You can re-summon NPCs as they die and switch weapons mid-fight, so lean into the summoned allies rather than duelling him alone.

steps: Find Marika's Omenring beneath the Frenzied Flame in the underground Ruins Ruins area of the Consecrated Snowfield.
Use the Omenring on Marika's Erdtree burial mound to receive the Mimic Tear Ashes.
Fight Nokstella/Eternal City with the Mimic Tear summoned and defeat the boss.

achievements.name: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
achievements.description: Defeat the golden shade of Godfrey.

steps: Reach Leyndell, Royal Capital through the capital's main rampart route.
Defeat the golden shade of Godfrey near the Erdtree Sanctuary, just before Morgott.
Fight Morgott at the base of the Erdtree in Leyndell.
He is an upgraded Margit — same moveset, faster, and he summons a seal in phase two. Margit's Shackle works here too.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Flame, Protect Me incantation trivialises his seal phase if you can spare the FP.

steps: Descend through the Ruin-Strewn Precipice dungeon north of Liurnia.
Reach the bottom cave and fight Makar — stay at his sides to avoid the magma breath and ground trails.

achievements.name: God-Slaying Armament
achievements.description: Upgraded any armament to its highest stage.

steps: Gather Smithing Stones: eight regular stones plus an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone for a standard weapon, or ten Somber Stones for a unique one.
Take any weapon to a Smithing Table and upgrade it to its final stage (+25, or +10 for unique arms).
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones are extremely limited — each playthrough only has a handful, so save them for one good weapon instead of spreading them.

steps: Travel to the Mountaintops of the Giants and cross the long chain bridge to the crater.
Attack the Fire Giant's wrapped ankle in phase one. In phase two he catches fire — stay under him and hit his hands while he pounds the ground.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Summoning spirit ashes distracts him and keeps him facing away while you hit the ankle.

steps: Reach the Forge of the Giants on the highest ridge of the Mountaintops.
Interact with the forge and walk into the Erdtree to set it ablaze.
warnings: Effectively missable for the rest of the game. Kindling the Erdtree commits you to the Frenzied Flame ending and permanently locks out Age of the Stars and Elden Lord. Only do this once every other ending and every Divine Tower is done.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: If you have not finished Ranni's questline or activated the other Divine Towers, do not touch the forge yet — this is the single most irreversible choice in the game.

steps: Find Castle Sol in the Mountaintops of the Giants, east of the Shack of the Lofty.
Kill the two mounted knights that flank him first, then focus Niall himself.
warnings: Commander Niall holds a legendary spirit ash. Defeating him is required for Legendary Ashen Remains — skipping him leaves that achievement permanently unobtainable in this run.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: His shield blocks frontal damage — circle behind him or use a jumping attack to get around it.

steps: Enter Volcano Manor in northern Liurnia and reach the boss arena deep inside.
Grab the Serpent-Hunter great spear from the arena entrance, then fight Rykard. The spear's Waterfowl Dance has enormous range and refunds HP on hit.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Serpent-Hunter spear is effectively required. Without it the fight is one of the hardest in the game.

achievements.name: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
achievements.description: Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void.

steps: Complete Ranni's questline to open the Lake of Rot, then descend into the Grand Cloister.
Fight Astel deep underground. Stay close — his grab and his void lightning both punish distance.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The fall damage on the way down is brutal and there is no way back up the shaft without an item — bring a way to survive it.

steps: Reach Crumbling Farum Azula and fight the Godskin Duo in the Dragon Temple Transcept.
Use Sleep Pots to put one to sleep, then finish it before the other wakes.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Sleep Pots are craftable from Trina's Lily and trivialize this fight. Save enough for the sleeping approach.

steps: Find the Godskin Noble in the Temple of Eiglay at the base of Volcano Manor.
Roll perpendicular to his rolling attack to dodge, then punish his long recovery windows.
Light all three flame braziers in Siofra River to activate the deer carcass.
Interact with the carcass to summon the Ancestor Spirit and defeat it.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The deer is very slow, so this is the easiest boss in the game — a good one to learn the parry timing on.

steps: Progress through Crumbling Farum Azula to the Beast Clergyman's chamber at the end of the Divine Dragon fight path.
Phase one he is a fast melee beast. Phase two he wields Destined Death — use the Blasphemous Blade's Golden Vow or a parry to counter.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Black Flame Tornado is very strong here, but Destined Death can one-shot you. Bring Golden Vow and don't be greedy with the parry.

steps: Reach Mohgwyn Palace via the Pureblood Knight's Medal from Varre's questline, or via the teleporter in the Consecrated Snowfield.
Fight Mohg with Mohg's Shackle to pin him in phase one. At 50% he enters a blood ritual — use a Purifying Crystal Tear in your Flask to survive it.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Purifying Crystal Tear, found in the Crystal Tear boss fight at the Second Church of Marika, completely negates the phase two heal.

steps: Progress through Leyndell, Ashen Capital to the Erdtree Sanctuary.
Defeat Godfrey's true form as Hoarah Loux. Phase two he drops the greatsword for devastating grabs and ground slams — roll the AoE stomps.
warnings: Missable. Hoarah Loux only appears if you have not kindled the Erdtree. If you set the Erdtree aflame first, this fight never triggers and the achievement cannot be earned in that run.

steps: Descend the Siofra Aqueduct into Nokron, Eternal City.
Kill the first gargoyle before it can wake the second — they are aggressive and their breath covers the whole ledge.

achievements.name: Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree
achievements.description: Defeat Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

steps: Navigate through Miquella's Haligtree to the boss arena beyond the drainage corridor.
Fight Loretta. She is a tougher version of the Caria Manor fight with added gravity attacks — close the gap quickly.
Travel to The Shaded Castle in the centre of the Altus Plateau.
Defeat Elemer. His telekinetic boulder has long range, so use a shield or dodge toward him to close the distance.
warnings: Elemer drops a legendary spirit ash. Defeating him is required for Legendary Ashen Remains — skipping the Shaded Castle leaves that achievement permanently unobtainable in this run.

achievements.name: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella
achievements.description: Defeat the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella.

steps: Find the Dragonkin Soldier deep in Ainsel River in Liurnia.
Stay close — the fight is quick and his combos punish ranged play.
Light all flames in Nokron/Siofra to activate the second deer carcass deeper underground.
Fight the Regal Ancestor Spirit. He shields constantly, so break his guard down fast before he heals.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The shield raises whenever he heals — waiting him out just gives him free HP. Hit through it with a heavy attack.

steps: Reach Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree and walk through the Scarlet Aeonia to the boss fog.
Learn the timing of Waterfowl Dance in phase one — the first flurry must be run out of, the second dodged into, and the third dodged away from.
In phase two she becomes the Goddess of Rot. Her Scarlet Aeonia covers most of the arena — move constantly and heal through it.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Widely considered the hardest boss in the game. Bleed builds are the most common answer, and Mimic Tear is a strong option if you can summon it.
warnings: She heals on every hit, even when blocked. Trading blows loses the fight — only damage her when she recovers from an attack.

steps: Find the hidden area beneath Leyndell in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds.
Break through the hidden wall and fall into the Consecrated Snowfield.
Fight this earlier, weaker version of Mohg. Same moveset as the Shardbearer but without the phase two blood ritual.
In Crumbling Farum Azula, cross the long bridge to the isolated platform.
Find the lie-down prompt on one of the floating ruins near the bridge and lie down to summon Placidusax.
Fight him on the narrow platform. His lightning fills the arena — stay close and roll into him.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The arena is tiny and his sweeping lightning has no safe corner — the safest play is to hug him rather than kite.
warnings: Missable. The lie-down prompt is very easy to walk past, and there is no marker for it. If you leave the platform without summoning him, you must come back across the bridge.

steps: Complete Fia's questline and descend into the Deeproot Depths.
Sleep in the Deathbed Dream to enter Nokstella, then defeat Lichdragon Fortissax. Lightning resistance or the lightning drake incantation helps a lot.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Defeat him outside Nokstella first as Lichdragon Fortissax's lesser form drops a great rune if you need the upgrade.

achievements.name: Age of the Stars
achievements.description: Reach the Age of the Stars ending.

steps: Complete Ranni's questline through to her final confrontation with the Moon Queen.
Walk away with Ranni and complete the final dialogue to receive the Dark Moon Ring.
warnings: Missable. Ranni's questline must be finished before you kindle the Erdtree. Burning the Erdtree first makes this ending permanently unavailable in that run.

steps: Finish Morgott, Godfrey, and then Hoarah Loux in the Erdtree Sanctuary.
Choose to take the Elden Throne and begin the endgame burn.
warnings: Missable. Requires defeating Morgott, Godfrey's first form, and Hoarah Loux without having kindled the Erdtree first.

steps: Collect all twelve legendary armaments across the game.
Final entries typically come from optional bosses and late-game dungeons, so check every minor location before moving on.
warnings: Missable. Several legendary armaments drop from optional content — the Bloodhound Knight's Finesse from the Ailing Village, the Eclipse Shotel from Castle Sol, and the Grafted Dragon Greatsword from the Dragon Communion Altar. Missing an area can hide one permanently.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Work the list at a late-game revisit rather than in story order — it is much easier to track down what you are still missing when you can reach everywhere freely.

steps: Find and defeat all ten legendary bosses that drop spirit ashes.
The last entries are in the Mountaintops and Haligtree, so this is effectively a late-game sweep.
warnings: Missable. Commander Niall (Castle Sol) and Elemer of the Briar (Shaded Castle) are both optional and must be deliberately defeated, or this achievement is unobtainable in that run.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Use the spirit ash you already have to clear content quickly — the point of this trophy is coverage, not difficulty.

steps: Collect all twenty legendary talismans spread across every major region.
Several are missable quest rewards, so finish side quests rather than fast-travelling through them.
warnings: Missable. A handful are only obtainable through optional questlines — including Millicent's quest in the Scadu Altus, which is easy to abandon early.

achievements.name: Legendary Sorceries and Incantations
achievements.description: Acquired all legendary sorceries and incantations.

steps: Find all legendary sorceries and incantations across the game.
Several come from optional mini-dungeons, so sweep every cave rather than following only the main path.

achievements.name: Lord of Frenzied Flame
achievements.description: Reach the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.

steps: Speak to Jerren at the Temple of Eiglay in southern Liurnia to begin the Flame of Ruin questline.
Complete it through to the Grand Mosque of Izalith in the Consecrated Snowfield.
Collect three Flame of Ruin incantations from the Chaos Avatar and unlock the Frenzied Flame option at the Erdtree.
warnings: Missable. The Frenzied Flame must be unlocked by finishing the Flame of Ruin questline BEFORE kindling the Erdtree. Doing the quest later is not possible once the Erdtree burns.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Do this quest early — it is long, entirely missable, and the reward is a one-way door.

steps: Obtain every other achievement in the game.
This is the completion trophy and only fires once the other 41 have unlocked.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Save it for last so you can tell at a glance what is still outstanding.
